notice.directive: Arrange an in-person assessment today. Do not wait for an asynchronous reply.

event.text: Please be assessed in person today for possible leg clot, at a service that can provide leg ultrasound promptly; if urgent care cannot arrange that assessment promptly, go to an emergency department instead. Do not wait for a messaging reply. I recommend a Counsel clinician follow up in this thread with results. If you develop chest pain, breathlessness, coughing blood, fainting or a fast heartbeat, call 911 immediately.
